reviews.title: 3 months later
reviews.comment:
I have nothing bad to say about this PSU. At first, I was leery buying it, but after my first PSU I had from CoolerMaster died and they expected me to pay for the repairs despite it being within warranty, I figured I'd buy a budget PSU. Rosewill has served me well so far.
First of all, I like their cable quality more than CoolerMaster. They're not quite EVGA level, as I have in my other PC, but I'd say they're acceptable.
Durability. Well, the jury is still out. It wasn't DOA.
It powers my RTX 5080 and Core Ultra 265k well. I wouldn't suggest trying to power a 5090 with this low if wattage, though. 750w is the minimum for a 5080.
reviews.author: MM

reviews.title: So far it works amazing
reviews.comment: Works perfectly with my RX7600 and R5 5600G so far its quite and compact and it does not make any buzzing noise. I will come back again for a review in 6 months to 1 year to see how well it holds up

reviews.title: Fantastic PSU
reviews.comment: Modularity makes installation suuuper easy. It’s quiet, the cabling is high quality, and the connectors snap right in and have great hold. 10/10. My whole PC is even upgradable w this PSU thanks to the 750W. I’m using less than half of that with my full build.
